value.rationale: Gaussian Fock zero-mode existence undergoes a natural and complete order/modulus phase transition. At the critical balanced order >=3, all n analytic modes survive in the Fock norm but fail to be in the integrability domain of their defining harmonic polynomial symbol, a structural obstruction relevant to interpreting polynomial Fock Toeplitz and squeezing expressions. There is no arbitrary finite-slice invariant.
